_doc: Your standing rules, in your words, injected into every prompt whose skill declares a matching scope (preprocessor/preferences.py; CLAUDE.md 'Personal rules'). kind: instruction (a quoted standing instruction), prefer (post / do), avoid (skip / never do), fact (about you: role, eligibility, interests). scopes: * (everywhere), briefing, mail-triage, funding, newsletters, newsletters:<list>, scheduling, drafting, manuscripts. Add with `preferences.py add`, or edit by hand. Retired rules keep status=retired for the record. calibration: how past runs landed and what you said.

rules.text: Standing or office-wide BAAs are not opportunities; skip them.
rules.quote: Office-wide BAAs are never real calls for me, skip them.

calibration.note: 1 of 17 posted (a dataset release); the user confirmed.
